name: 移动分组
desc: 列表行尾有「移动到其他分组」按钮：点开浮层列出全部分组（当前分组标「当前分组」），选另一个分组后任务归属即时改变、副标题与侧栏计数同步、浮层关闭、分组变更落盘；点「取消」只关闭浮层不改数据

steps.eval: if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.wipe = async () => { const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); sessionStorage.setItem('__todo_store_id', JSON.stringify({ id: 'conjure-todo-app-test', exp: Date.now() + 600000 })); const K = '__todo_test_backup_v1'; if (localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_dirty') === '1') { const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K) || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } } const snap = { todos: await s.getItem('todos'), groups: await s.getItem('groups'), ui: await s.getItem('ui') }; localStorage.setItem(K, JSON.stringify(snap)); localStorage.setItem('__todo_test_dirty', '1'); await s.removeItem('todos'); await s.removeItem('groups'); await s.removeItem('ui'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'wiped, backup todos=' + (snap.todos ? snap.todos.length : 0); }; return await T.wipe();

if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.q = (s) => { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); const r = p && p.shadowRoot; return r ? Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s)) : []; }; T.ready = async (sel, ms) => { const n = Math.ceil((ms || 3000) / 100); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (T.q(sel).length) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('页面就绪超时，找不到 ' + sel); }; T.tx = (el) => el.textContent.trim(); T.click = (el) => { if (!el) throw new Error('元素不存在'); const b = el.shadowRoot && el.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); (b || el).click(); return true; }; T.byText = (sel, t) => T.q(sel).find((e) => T.tx(e) === t) || null; T.btn = (t) => T.click(T.byText('st-button', t)); T.dlg = () => T.q('st-dialog').find((d) => d.hasAttribute('open')) || null; T.dlgBtn = (t) => { const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('当前没有打开的弹窗'); const b = Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((x) => T.tx(x) === t); if (!b) throw new Error('弹窗里找不到按钮：' + t); return T.click(b); }; T.wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms || 300)); T.NL = String.fromCharCode(10); T.setVal = (el, v) => { if (!el) throw new Error('输入元素不存在'); el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true; }; T.items = () => T.q('.list .item'); T.need = (t) => { const i = T.items().find((x) => T.tx(x.querySelector('.text')) === t); if (!i) throw new Error('找不到任务：' + t); return i; }; T.gcount = (name) => { const g = T.q('.gitem').find((x) => T.tx(x.querySelector('.gname')) === name); if (!g) throw new Error('找不到分组：' + name); return T.tx(g.querySelector('.gcount')); }; T.newGroup = async (name) => { T.btn('新建分组'); await T.wait(350); T.setVal(T.dlg().querySelector('.dialog-input'), name); await T.wait(250); T.dlgBtn('创建'); await T.wait(450); return true; }; T.addTask = async (title, desc) => { T.btn('添加任务'); await T.wait(350); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('添加弹窗未打开'); T.setVal(d.querySelector('.dialog-field'), desc ? title + T.NL + desc : title); await T.wait(250); T.dlgBtn('添加'); await T.wait(400); return true; }; T.openMove = async (title) => { T.click(T.need(title).querySelector('.move-btn')); await T.wait(400); const mask = T.q('.move-mask')[0]; if (!mask || getComputedStyle(mask).display === 'none') throw new Error('点「移动到其他分组」应打开浮层'); return true; }; T.moveOpts = () => T.q('.move-item'); T.moveOpt = (name) => { const b = T.moveOpts().find((x) => T.tx(x.querySelector('.move-name')) === name); if (!b) throw new Error('浮层里找不到分组：' + name); return b; }; return 'helpers ready';

await T.ready('.add-group-btn'); await T.newGroup('工作'); await T.addTask('搬家', ''); if (T.tx(T.need('搬家').querySelector('.meta')).indexOf('默认 · ') !== 0) throw new Error('初始应在默认分组'); const mb = T.need('搬家').querySelector('.move-btn'); if (!mb) throw new Error('列表行尾应有「移动到其他分组」按钮'); if ((mb.getAttribute('title') || '').indexOf('移动到其他分组') !== 0) throw new Error('按钮 title 不正确：' + mb.getAttribute('title')); await T.openMove('搬家'); const names = T.moveOpts().map((b) => T.tx(b.querySelector('.move-name'))); if (names.join(',') !== '默认,工作') throw new Error('浮层应列出全部分组：' + names.join(',')); if (T.tx(T.moveOpt('默认').querySelector('.move-hint')) !== '当前分组') throw new Error('当前所在分组应标「当前分组」'); if (T.tx(T.q('.move-title')[0]).indexOf('搬家') === -1) throw new Error('浮层标题应带上任务名'); T.click(T.moveOpt('工作')); await T.wait(500); if (getComputedStyle(T.q('.move-mask')[0]).display !== 'none') throw new Error('选完分组后浮层应关闭'); const meta = T.tx(T.need('搬家').querySelector('.meta')); if (meta.indexOf('工作 · ') !== 0) throw new Error('任务应移到「工作」分组：' + meta); if (T.gcount('工作') !== '1 项' || T.gcount('默认') !== '0 项') throw new Error('侧栏计数未跟随：' + T.gcount('工作') + ' / ' + T.gcount('默认')); return 'ok：浮层选项与当前分组标记正确、移动后归属与计数同步';

await T.openMove('搬家'); if (T.tx(T.moveOpt('工作').querySelector('.move-hint')) !== '当前分组') throw new Error('再次打开时「工作」应标为当前分组'); T.click(T.byText('.move-actions st-button', '取消')); await T.wait(400); if (getComputedStyle(T.q('.move-mask')[0]).display !== 'none') throw new Error('点「取消」应关闭浮层'); if (T.tx(T.need('搬家').querySelector('.meta')).indexOf('工作 · ') !== 0) throw new Error('取消不应改变分组'); const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); const todos = await s.getItem('todos'); const t = (todos || []).find((x) => x.text === '搬家'); if (!t) throw new Error('存储里找不到任务'); const groups = await s.getItem('groups'); const g = (groups || []).find((x) => x.name === '工作'); if (!g || t.groupId !== g.id) throw new Error('分组变更未落盘：' + t.groupId); if (t.done || t.deletedAt || t.archivedAt) throw new Error('移动不应改变完成 / 删除 / 归档状态'); return 'ok：取消不改数据、分组归属已落盘';

const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); sessionStorage.removeItem('__todo_store_id'); const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_backup_v1') || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } localStorage.removeItem('__todo_test_dirty'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'restored';
